system.name: UniLSeg
system.one_liner: A universal segmentation model that segments at any semantic level, from object part to whole scene, guided by a language instruction.

content.variant_note: seven aligned colour-coded columns, each a segmentation example with its language instruction and semantic-level tag, ordered along a Bottom to Top granularity arrow
content.argues: UniLSeg segments targets at every semantic level, from object part to whole scene, according to the language instruction it is given.
content.subject: Seven examples of language-guided masks, from a bird's head to a whole bedroom, each with its instruction and semantic-level tag

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a range of granularity (or difficulty) as parallel columns in one layout: result photo, language instruction and level tag, one hue per column, ordered along a labelled Bottom to Top arrow, so the reader sees that only the instruction and the target change.
lessons.suits: Teasers of promptable or multi-level models (segmentation, detection, captioning) whose claim is a range of inputs rather than a pipeline.

summary: UniLSeg is a universal segmentation model that segments at any semantic level, from object parts to whole scenes, when given a language instruction. Figure 1 is a teaser in a dashed frame on a pale green ground: seven colour-coded columns ordered along a grey Bottom to Top arrow labelled Semantic Understanding Level. Each column stacks a photo with its mask in translucent red (top row, Seg. Mask), the quoted instruction that selects it (middle row, Lang.: head, all faces, the most salient object, man looking this way, mom and kid, wall, bed, light, shelf, et al.) and a level tag (bottom row, Sem. Level: part, part, instance, instance, group, class, scene), joined by hollow up arrows. The model itself is not drawn.
summary_zh: UniLSeg 能按语言指令在任意语义粒度上做分割。图是一条从“底”到“顶”的粒度轴，七列同色的示例从上到下依次是带红色掩码的照片、引用的语言指令和语义层级标签（部件、实例、群组、类别、场景），用空心箭头相连。
notes: Prior kinds kept (scope-overview, concept-schematic) with the example-gallery variant. The model is not drawn. The last tile carries a multi-colour class map rather than one red mask. The dotted up arrows link level to instruction and the solid ones instruction to mask; the figure does not say why the two differ. The seven photos are 67 x 47 pt bitmaps.
